title: Vehicle Weapon
description: Canonical vehicle-weapon record (SHIP YARD S4 JOB 3b, ruling shipyard-s4-workbench-contracts R-S4WC-5; the brief's ADDENDUM 1 A1.1 as ratified with B1-B3). One record per Table 7-17 row (EotE p.271): its price, rarity, (R) and silhouette range, and Table 7-1's profile for its type (EotE p.230; verified via FaD p.234). Produced by scripts/canonical/build_vehicle_weapons.py from OggDude's weapons; every value is checked against the printed tables by test/vehicle_weapons_book.cjs (0 deviations). The book's '—' is null, never 0 (B3).

allOf.$comment: ADDENDUM 4 H-2: a Table 7-17 row carries every Table 7-17 value; the four may be null only outside it.

id.description: OggDude's key: the vocabulary the hulls' embedded weapon rows already use (LASERMED, LASERQUAD, ...). S8 (card shipyard-s8-build ADDENDUM 4 H-2): a row outside Table 7-17 takes an id of its own (BLASTLTREP_VEH), kept apart from OggDude's personal-weapon keys by its suffix.

price.description: null ONLY on a row outside Table 7-17 (`table`): the book prints no ship-weapon value for it, so it is never sold or priced (card shipyard-s8-build ADDENDUM 4 H-2).

rarity.description: null ONLY on a row outside Table 7-17 (`table`): the book prints no ship-weapon value for it, so it is never sold or priced (card shipyard-s8-build ADDENDUM 4 H-2).

restricted.description: null ONLY on a row outside Table 7-17 (`table`): the book prints no ship-weapon value for it, so it is never sold or priced (card shipyard-s8-build ADDENDUM 4 H-2).

silhouette.description: Table 7-17's 'Silhouette that can mount it'. A hull within the range FITS; the verdict is information, never a gate (p.271: 'guidelines').

profile.description: Table 7-1's row for the weapon's type (R-S4WC-4): a swapped-in weapon prints this, as one weapon.

cite.description: The printed page the profile's table sits on (B2: 'eote p.230').
The printed page Table 7-17 sits on (B2: 'eote p.271'); outside Table 7-17, the page that prints the row ('eote p.250').

table.description: SHIP YARD S8 (card shipyard-s8-build ADDENDUM 4 H-2): the printed table the row comes from — "EotE Table 7-17" on the 18, "EotE p.250 (Aratech 74-Z)" on the light repeating blaster a conversion adds (R-S8C-12 G-2).

scale_note.description: TOLD: a printed note on the profile's scale (EotE p.250's "uses personal scale"), until B-216's scale field.

corrections.description: B3: a value where the book and OggDude differ, corrected to the book and citing it. The guard passes one only when the book's value equals `to` and OggDude's `from`.

inferred.description: RELEASE 1.0 R5 (card release-r5-data ADDENDUM 6 Q1, R-Y2-1 on paper there): a value the printed page does not read cleanly, so it carries OggDude's value until Jason reads the page strip. `field` is the dotted path, as in `corrections`; `value` EQUALS the record's value at `field`; `cite` is the unreadable printed page; `why` names what the page lost. No field sits in both `inferred` and `corrections`. The OCR inspection list is GENERATED from these entries (scripts/canonical/vehicle_weapons_ocr_list.py), never hand-kept. When the strip is read, an entry becomes a `corrections` row (book ≠ OggDude) or leaves (book = OggDude). This registry's vocabulary only; another registry adopting it is a later ruling.
